description: This file defines the Jsr239CodeEmitter class, which generates Java and C code for OpenGL functions, including different versions and extensions, for Android's graphics interface.

classes.name: Jsr239CodeEmitter
classes.description: A code emitter class that generates Java and C code for OpenGL functions, supporting multiple versions and extensions.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the current Java interface stream based on OpenGL version, extension, and pack flags.

methods.name: emitCode
methods.description: Generates code for a given C function, writing to Java and C streams.

methods.name: emitNativeRegistration
methods.description: Emits registration code for native OpenGL functions.
